name: JWT
description: JSON Web Token configurations and validations
attack_surface: Authorization HTTP headers, token header algorithms, payload parameters
common_misconfigurations: Accepting tokens signed with 'none' algorithm header options
Missing signature verification checks on backend API routes
Weak signing keys susceptible to offline brute force cracking attempts
validation_methods: Modify algorithm parameter to 'none' and test backend acceptance
Brute force signature key locally using offline key crack programs
evidence_requirements: Trace showing success responses for algorithm-less tokens with modified user sub keys
Cracked signing secret key matching client JWT configurations
false_positive_indicators: Backend rejecting modified payloads despite returning success code on parsing stage
WAF blocking token structure changes on the network gateway
reporting_guidance: High priority focus area. Token validation bypasses resulting in profile access are critical severity.
